label: constant
calculus: y independent of x ⇒ ∂y/∂x = 0.

label: identity
calculus: y = x ⇒ dy = dx (JVP: @y = @x).

label: add
calculus: y = x + x ⇒ dy/dx = 2.

label: sub
calculus: y = x − c ⇒ dy = dx.

label: product
calculus: y = x² ⇒ dy = 2x dx.

label: product_two_vars
calculus: y = ab ⇒ dy = a db + b da.

label: quotient
calculus: y = a/b ⇒ dy = (b da − a db) / b².

label: power_const
calculus: y = x^n ⇒ dy = n x^(n−1) dx.

label: power_square
calculus: y = x² ⇒ dy = 2x dx.

label: neg
calculus: y = −x ⇒ dy = −dx.

label: chain_let
calculus: z = x², y = 2z ⇒ dz = 2x dx, dy = 2 dz.

label: exp_scalar
calculus: y = e^x ⇒ dy = e^x dx.

label: exp_einstein
calculus: e[i] = exp(x[i]) ⇒ @e[i] = exp(x[i]) @x[i] (elementwise).

label: sum_reduction
calculus: s = Σ_k exp(x[k]) ⇒ ∂s/∂x_i = exp(x_i); with intermediate e, @s = Σ @e.

label: softmax_quotient
calculus: y[i] = e[i]/s, s = Σ e[k]; quotient + sum rule ⇒ @y[i] = (s @e[i] − e[i] @s)/s².

label: if_else
calculus: Piecewise: y = x if x>0 else 0 ⇒ dy = dx on active branch, 0 else.

label: scalar_mul
calculus: y = c x ⇒ dy = c dx.

label: compound
calculus: y = (x+1)*(x+2); product + chain rules.

label: call_plus_fn
calculus: y = x + f(x); with f(t)=t+1 inlined, f'=1 ⇒ @y = 2 @x (generic rule would be @y = @x + @f).

label: multistatement_callee_g
calculus: g(t)=2(t+1); y=g(x) ⇒ chain rule through internal lets.

label: log_scalar
calculus: y = ln x ⇒ dy = dx / x.

label: sin_scalar
calculus: y = sin x ⇒ dy = cos x dx.

label: cos_scalar
calculus: y = cos x ⇒ dy = −sin x dx.

label: tan_scalar
calculus: y = tan x ⇒ dy = sec² x dx.

label: log1p_scalar
calculus: y = ln(1+x) ⇒ dy = dx / (1+x).

label: expm1_scalar
calculus: y = e^x − 1 ⇒ dy = e^x dx.

label: atan_scalar
calculus: y = arctan x ⇒ dy = dx / (1+x²).

label: asin_scalar
calculus: y = arcsin x ⇒ dy = dx / √(1−x²).

label: acos_scalar
calculus: y = arccos x ⇒ dy = −dx / √(1−x²).

label: atan2_two_vars
calculus: z = atan2(y,x) ⇒ ∂z/∂y = x/(x²+y²), ∂z/∂x = −y/(x²+y²).
expected_einlang: let @z = x / (x * x + y * y) * @y + -y / (x * x + y * y) * @x;

label: tanh_scalar
calculus: y = tanh x ⇒ dy = sech² x dx (here via stable exp form).

label: sinh_scalar
calculus: y = sinh x ⇒ dy = cosh x dx (piecewise exp for stability).

label: cosh_scalar
calculus: y = cosh x ⇒ dy = sinh x dx.

label: asinh_scalar
calculus: y = asinh x ⇒ dy = dx / √(1+x²) (algebraic form in IR).

label: acosh_scalar
calculus: y = acosh x ⇒ dy = dx / √(x²−1) (x>1).

label: atanh_scalar
calculus: y = artanh x ⇒ dy = dx / (1−x²) (chain on log form in IR).

label: erf_scalar
calculus: y = erf(x) (A&S primal in stdlib); JVP is @fn rule ∂y/∂x = (2/√π) e^(−x²) dx.

label: abs_scalar
calculus: y = |x| ⇒ dy = sign(x) dx (0 subgradient choice at 0).

label: sign_scalar
calculus: y = sign(x) ⇒ dy = 0 off 0 (subgradient).

label: min_scalar
calculus: y = min(x,c) ⇒ dy = dx on x<c, 0 on x>c.

label: max_scalar
calculus: y = max(x,0) ⇒ dy = dx on x>0, 0 on x<0.

label: reciprocal_scalar
calculus: y = 1/x ⇒ dy = −dx / x².

label: mod_scalar
calculus: y = a % b with b fixed ⇒ ∂y/∂a = 1 a.e. (piecewise).

label: quotient_chain
calculus: Nested quotients; quotient + chain rules.

label: prod_reduction
calculus: Product over index; log-derivative / product rule.

label: reduce_sum
calculus: Row sum of x ⇒ each @output[batch] = Σ_j @x[batch,j].

label: reduce_l1
calculus: Σ_j |x_j|; ∂/∂x_j = sign(x_j) (JVP: Σ sign(x)·@x).

label: reduce_sum_square
calculus: Σ x² ⇒ ∂/∂x_ij = 2 x_ij.

label: reduce_mean
calculus: mean = (1/n) Σ x ⇒ same as sum scaled by 1/n.

label: linear
calculus: y[b,j] = Σ_k W[j,k] x[b,k] + b[j] ⇒ matrix-vector product rule per row.

label: mse_loss
calculus: L = (1/n) Σ (pred−target)² (no ½); ∂L/∂pred = 2(pred−target)/n (and ∂L/∂target = −2(pred−target)/n).

label: mae_loss
calculus: L = (1/n) Σ |pred−target|; ∂L/∂pred = (1/n) Σ sign(pred−target) (pairwise; @fn abs).

label: huber_loss
calculus: Smooth L1: quadratic inside |r|≤δ, linear outside; d|r| = sign(r) dr (@fn abs) in linear branch.

label: binary_cross_entropy
calculus: −Σ [ t log p + (1−t) log(1−p) ]; ∂/∂p = −t/p + (1−t)/(1−p) with clamp.

label: softmax
calculus: y_i = exp(z_i)/Σ exp(z_k); ∂y_i/∂z_j = y_i (δ_ij − y_j) (stable z = x − max).

label: log_softmax
calculus: log softmax = z − log Σ exp(z); derivative combines softmax Jacobian and shift.

label: reduce_l2
reduce_log_sum
calculus: log(Σ x) ⇒ ∂/∂x_i = 1/(Σ x).

label: reduce_log_sum_exp
calculus: log Σ exp(x) (log-sum-exp); ∂/∂x_i = softmax_i.

label: cosine_similarity
calculus: dot(a,b)/(‖a‖‖b‖); gradients are projections orthogonal to a and b in numerator layout.

label: matmul
calculus: C[i,j] = Σ_k A[i,k] B[k,j] ⇒ @C[i,j] = Σ_k (A[i,k] @B[k,j] + B[k,j] @A[i,k]).

label: batch_matmul
calculus: Same as matmul per batch slice b: @C[b,i,j] = Σ_k (A[b,i,k] @B[b,k,j] + B[b,k,j] @A[b,i,k]).

label: relu
calculus: y = max(0,x) ⇒ dy = dx if x>0 else 0.

label: leaky_relu
calculus: y = x if x>0 else α x ⇒ piecewise 1 or α.

label: elu
calculus: y = x if x>0 else α(e^x−1) ⇒ 1 or α e^x.

label: swish
calculus: y = x σ(x) ⇒ product + σ' term.

label: softsign
calculus: y = x/(1+|x|) ⇒ quotient rule with d|x| = sign(x) dx (@fn abs).

label: hardtanh
calculus: clip to [−1,1] ⇒ derivative 1 inside, 0 outside.

label: relu6
calculus: min(max(x,0),6) ⇒ piecewise 1 on (0,6), else 0.

label: prelu
calculus: like leaky_relu with learned α.

label: elu_alpha
calculus: ELU with parameter α.

label: celu
calculus: continuously differentiable ELU variant.

label: softshrink
calculus: shrink toward zero by λ; derivative 1 outside ±λ, 0 inside.

label: hardshrink
calculus: 0 if |x|≤λ else x; derivative via |x| and thresholds.

label: threshold
calculus: y = x if x>θ else v; piecewise.

label: hardswish
calculus: x * ReLU6(x+3)/6; product + ReLU6 branches.

label: thresholded_relu
calculus: ReLU with threshold θ.

label: selu
calculus: scaled ELU with fixed λ, α.

label: hardsigmoid
calculus: piecewise linear clamp of (x+3)/6.

label: softplus
calculus: log(1+e^x); derivative ≈ σ(x); large-x linearization.

label: gelu
calculus: x Φ(x) (approx); product + tanh-inner derivative in implementation.

label: mish
calculus: x tanh(softplus(x)); product + chain.

label: tanhshrink
calculus: x − tanh x ⇒ @y = @x − sech² x @x.
